arguments.content:
# Multi-Agent LLM Task Delegation and Delegation Chains

## Overview
Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems manage complex workflows by distributing responsibilities across multiple specialized components. Task delegation serves as the core mechanism that enables these systems to break down high-level objectives into manageable subtasks, which are then assigned to agents optimized for specific functions.

## Task Delegation Mechanisms
Delegation in multi-agent LLM systems primarily relies on objective decomposition. A central process or lead agent analyzes a complex goal and splits it into discrete subtasks.
